name: Free City of Lübeck
alt: Free and Hanseatic City of Lübeck

predecessors.name: Free Imperial City of Lübeck
predecessors.text: the Free Imperial City of Lübeck with the Bergedorf condominium

successors.name: Weimar Republic
successors.text: the state as it stood in 1870, unchanged to November 1918 (Free City of Lübeck, a state of the Weimar Republic)

ledger.x: 1868: Lübeck sells its share in Bergedorf to Hamburg.
November 1918: Lübeck, a free city with no monarch, passes from the Empire's member states to a state of the Weimar Republic.

wars.name: War of the Fourth Coalition
wars.outcome: Bernadotte's troops 'occupied neutral Lübeck after a battle against Blücher on 6 November 1806'; Lübeck was annexed by France in 1811.

wars.name: War of the Sixth Coalition
wars.outcome: Lübeck 'regained its pre-1811 status in 1813'; the Bouches-de-l'Elbe department was redivided in 1814.

certainty.note: No page gives Lübeck's boundary; Bergedorf was a condominium shared with Hamburg, so its frontier is soft throughout.
After the sale of Bergedorf the state is the city with its own land; no page gives the line, but nothing else was shared.
